title: AWS Lambda Secrets Manager with ABAC
description: Use attribute-based access control (ABAC) to control access to a secret stored in Secrets Manager.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: In this pattern, we explore the use of attribute-based access control (ABAC) to enable access to a secret in AWS Secrets Manager by an AWS Lambda function.
